form.nodeNameHint: Saving updates the name after # in the subscription URL.
form.externalUriHint: Enter one Anywhere-compatible node URI per line. Protocol parameters are preserved. External nodes are not included in local traffic usage.
form.cropIconHint: Drag to reposition and use the slider to zoom. The result is compressed to a 96×96 PNG.

form.iconInputTooLarge: The source image must not exceed 5 MiB
form.iconOutputTooLarge: The compressed icon still exceeds 32 KiB. Choose a simpler image.

import.title: Subscription and import
import.outputPreferencesHint: When expanded, mix Tunnels emit every valid TCP/UDP combination. Saving applies immediately to this subscription URL.
import.unavailable: This subscription does not have an available subscription URL.
import.vectorUnavailable: This Tunnel does not have an available Vector address.
import.qrError: Unable to generate this QR code. Copy the address instead.
import.qrHint: Scan in Anywhere or recognize the code from your photo library first; copy the subscription address only if needed.
import.vectorQrHint: Scan in Anywhere or recognize the Vector address from your photo library.
import.qrStepOne: Save the QR code on this screen.
import.qrStepTwo: Complete the scan or import inside Anywhere.

externalTraffic.title: Confirm subscription save
externalTraffic.message: This subscription contains imported protocol nodes. Traffic usage can only be measured for Nowhere Tunnels created in this dashboard. Traffic from imported nodes is not included in this subscription's usage.

rotate.title: Rotate subscription token
rotate.message: Rotating the token for “{{name}}” immediately invalidates the old subscription URL. Clients using it must import the new URL.

reset.title: Reset subscription traffic
reset.message: Reset used traffic for “{{name}}” to zero and clear its over-limit state. The traffic limit is unchanged.

delete.title: Delete subscription
delete.message: Deleting “{{name}}” permanently invalidates its public subscription URL. Associated Tunnels are not deleted.
